propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls with default max_results=50, silently truncating projects with more than 50 issues
issues beyond the first 50 appear to have no links or incomplete comments, causing the differ to emit spurious mutations and miss removals
three methods (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map, get_parent_map) each hand-roll pagination logic independently, creating maintenance debt and enabling recurrence of the truncation bug
a shared _paged_search helper must advance pagination by len(batch) and terminate only on empty pages, accounting for Jira DC silently truncating maxResults above the server limit
get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map must recover all issues from projects with more than 50 issues, including full link and comment payloads on all pages
